name: Made In America

matches.note: Miles rolled on top for the pin after Buddy Brown and an unidentified masked 7'1" man ran in and gave running chokeslams to both wrestlers.
Johnson finished Miles with a top-rope tombstone he calls the Showstoppah, about ten minutes in.
Canibus never showed; Tiger advanced by forfeit.
The Rebel distracted the referee while Tiger hit both wrestlers with a steel chair; Martens covered Hellscream for the pin.
The match was restarted after a second referee ruled The Rebel had his feet on the ropes during an earlier pin; Johnson then finished him with a heart-punch ("The Stud") followed by the Showstoppah.
Tiger battered Martens (already bandaged from an earlier chair shot) and pinned him with a double underhook DDT onto a steel chair.
The Dominators won the fed's own first Tag Team Championship with their finisher, Total Domination, in a final that ran past its own 30-minute time limit and had to be restarted.

The tournament final. The Rebel hit Johnson with a chair as he set up his own finisher; Tiger then caught Johnson in a top-rope Victory Roll for the pin and the fed's own first Heavyweight Championship.

notes: The fed's own first pay-per-view, fourteen matches total; six further matches (Voices In Your Head over Big Daddy Cruel & Bone Breaker Kid; AfterShock over Juan Clement; The Dominators over The Rock And Roll Express; Rage vs. Marko Clement to a double countout; Sportsmaster over Maximus) are not structured, their combatants unminted, and survive in the served page's own verbatim text.

name: Tuesday Time Bomb

date.source: The fed's own broadcast, posted 27 May 1998.

appearances.source: The fed's own Tuesday Time Bomb broadcast, in which he announces the United States and Lightweight Title tournament brackets on-camera.

matches.note: A rematch of the two men's tournament meeting; Clement won this time.
Rival stable The Public Enemy interfered on Fort Knox's behalf: Swap Meet Louie distracted the referee while Ghetto Boy hit Satre with a somersault legdrop, letting Fort Knox roll over for the pin.
The Public Enemy attacked Brown just as he set up his own finisher, then turned on Miles too; the match ended in a four-on-one brawl with no decision.

notes: President Collins appears on-air to announce brackets for a new United States Title (an eight-man Battle Bowl) and a Lightweight Title tournament, naming several wrestlers not minted. Three further matches (Thunder & Lightning vs. The Apocalyptic Warriors; The Messiah over Ice Lord; Tracker over Rogue Warrior) are not structured and survive in the served page's own verbatim text.
